feature_definitions.peak_over_tile_rms: Peak minus robust tile sky, divided by sigma-clipped tile pixel RMS; not physical source SNR
feature_definitions.nearest_detected_peak_px: Distance to next detected 6-sigma peak; unresolved neighbors invisible
feature_definitions.neighbors_within_25px: Count of detected 6-sigma peaks within 25 native pixels, excluding self
feature_definitions.annulus_mad_over_tile_rms: MAD-based annulus (5 to 10 px) texture / robust tile pixel RMS; may include source wings

limitations: Post-hoc descriptive stratification cannot identify causes
6-sigma peak catalog misses unresolved or faint neighbors
Bright isolated candidates only; not representative of faint crowded stars
All source L1 values are from unchanged native-pixel v0.12 templates
Image peak-over-tile-RMS is not a calibrated flux SNR
No independent Gaia absolute astrometry or calibrated photometry
